title: ShutterNFT
tagline: Shutter is a video stock where people can download for free and use it anywhere.
description: This project is about videos. Using ShutterNFT, users can upload videos which can be downloaded by anyone. These videos will be license-free and can be used anywhere. The videos will be in the form of NFT ERC-721. Currently, we only have the option to mint and upload to Livepeer and IPFS.
how_its_made: This project is made using @Livepeer and @Filecoin. We have deployed the contract on the Polygon Mumbai Testnet . We have used Livepeer to upload video using their Hooks after we uploaded it to IPFS and stored the URL in JSON and put it in the NFT URI storage. Finally, it will be in the form of an NFT, so anyone can download and use it for free. We are still in development.
